वप् {c1c} U. (वपति, वपते, उप्त; pass.
उप्यते; desid. विवप्सति-ते)
1 To sow,
scatter (as seed), plant; यथेरिणे
बीजमुप्त्वा न वप्ता लभते फलं

; Ś. 6. 23.
--2 To throw,
cast (as dice).
--3 To beget, produce.
--4 To weave.
--5 To shear, shave
(mostly Vedic). --Caus. (वापयति-ते)
To sow, plant, put into the ground.

1 Sowing seed.
--2 One who
sows, a sower.
--3 Shaving.
--4
Weaving.

वापः [वप्-घञ्]
1 Sowing seed.
--2 Weaving.
--3 Shaving, shearing;

.
--3
Semen virile, seed.
--नी
1 A
barber's shop.
--2 A weaving
instrument.
--3 A weaver's shop (तंतुशाला).

.
--2 A hole, cavity.
--3 A
mound of earth thrown up by ants.
--4 The skin of the intestines.
--Comp.
--कृत् m. marrow.

वपुस् a. [वप्-उसि] Handsome,
beautiful (Ved.) --n.
1 (a) Body,
person; (स्मरं) वपुषा स्वेन
नियोजयिष्यति

; Śi. 10. 50. (b) Form,
figure, appearance; लिखितवपुषौ
शंखपद्मौ च दृष्ट्वा

.
--3 Beauty, a
beautiful form or appearance.
--4 Ved.
A wonderful phenomenon, wonder.
--5 Ved. Water.
--Comp.
--गुणः,
--प्रकर्षः excellence of form, personal
beauty; संधुक्षयंतीव वपुर्गुणेन

.
--धर a. {1} embodied. {2}
beautiful.
--स्रवः a humour of the
body.

वपुष्मत् a.
1 Embodied,
incarnate, corporeal; ददृशे जगतीभुजा मुनिः
स वपुष्मानिव पुण्यसंचयः

.
--2 Beautiful, handsome. --m.
N. of one of the Viśvedevas.

वप्तृ m. [वप्-तृच्]
1 A sower (of
seed), planter, husbandman; न
शालेः स्तंबकरिता वप्तुर्गुणमपेक्षते

.
--2 A father, procreator.
--3 A poet, an inspired sage.
--4 A
shaver, cutter.

वप्रः --प्रं [उप्यते अत्र वप्-रन्]
1 A
rampart, earth-work, mud-wall;
वेलावप्रवलयां (उर्वीं)

.
--2 A
bank or mound of any kind (against
which bulls and elephants butt);

; see वप्रक्रीडा below.
--3
The slope or declivity of a hill or
rocky place; बृहच्छिलावप्रघनेन वक्षसा

.
--4 A summit, peak,
table-land on a mountain; तीव्रं
महाव्रसमिवात्र चरंति वप्राः Śi. 4. 58, 3. 37;

.
--5 The bank of
a river, side, shore, bank in general;
ध्वनयः प्रतेनुरनुव प्रमपां

.
--6 The foundation of a
building.
--7 The gate of a
fortified town.
--8 A ditch.
--9 The
circumference of a sphere.
--10 A
field in general.
--11 The butting of
an elephant or bull.
--12 Dust.
--प्रः
1 A father.
--2 A Prajāpati.
--प्रं
Lead.
--Comp.
--अभिघातः butting
against the bank or side (as of a
hill, river &c.);

; cf.
तटाघात.
--क्रिया, --क्रीडा the playful
butting of an elephant (or bull) against
a bank or mound;
वप्रक्रियामृक्षवतस्तटेषु

.

--9 The

--10 A

--11 The butting of

--12 Dust.

Lead.

wheel.

1 A field.
--2 The ocean.
--3
Difficult position (दुर्गति).
वप्री A mound of earth, hillock.
